summary.zh: 截至昨日，本周登记32项、九人均有成果；16—17日执行缺口与独立验收零不能被周覆盖掩盖。
summary.en: Through yesterday, 32 registered deliveries cover all nine citizens; coverage does not erase November 16–17 gaps or zero independent acceptance.

limitation.zh: 作者成果；具体限制见正文；未独立验收。
limitation.en: Author work; scope limits in artifact; no independent acceptance.
